description:
Capture live events from Sources in Cribl Stream. 
    Events are different from "logs" in that they are the raw data flowing through Cribl, rather than logs generated by Cribl.
    When to run this tool:
      - When a user asks for real-time events from a Source/Destination
      - To check if Data is flowing through a Source/Destination as expected
      - You need sample events to test a pipeline. You must be certain the Pipeline will be connected to this Source.

id.description: The ID of the Source (inputId) or Destination (outputId) to capture events from

artifactClass.description:
Must be either "input" or "output".
          Use the get_sources or get_destinations tools to verify the Source or Destination, if needed.

description: Select a Source to use for the next step. When to run this tool: When a user asks for a Source to use for the next step
This tool passes sample events through a Pipeline and validates that the output events match the target schema. It returns a list of errors, if any are found.

sampleId.description: The id of the sample to run through the Pipeline.

pipelineId.description: The id of the Pipeline to run.

description: Save a Pipeline plan to Cribl Stream. Always pass the full plan content.

plan.description: The Pipeline plan content, typically in markdown or JSON format.

description: Save a Pipeline configuration to Cribl Stream. Always pass the full Pipeline object.

This tool will save sample events to a sample File. 
  When to run this tool:
    - After the user provides sample events
  Make sure to follow these instructions when running this tool:
  - Pass the full array of events
  - Do not parse events into a different format. 
    - If a string is provided, assume it is the _raw field of the event.
    - If a JSON object is provided, you may treat that as an event.

sampleEventsArray.description: The sample events to save. Should be an array of objects.

description:
This tool will save the target schema to a file.
  When to run this tool:
    - After a target schema object has been generated by another tool.

properties.description: This must be filled with the appropriate properties of the target schema.

targetSchema.description: A JSON Schema object that describes the target schema. Always pass the full schema object.

description: This tool renders a Cascader with 3 categories: 1) Recommended Target Schemas and 2) All Supported Target Schemas (split by schema type). Run this tool when it's time to select a target schema.

recommendedTargetSchemas.description: Recommended target schema IDs for the user to pick from, ordered by fit with the input events — the first element MUST be your single best recommendation, followed by progressively weaker fits. The user sees this order in the UI and the first element is treated as the top pick. Allowed to be empty.

description:
Use this tool to provide clickable next steps for the user to take.
  When to run this tool:
  - At the beginning of every thread to provide the user with initial options.
  - Every time you ask a question to the user.

  Use the result of this tool to dictate which action to take next.

steps.description: An array of next steps to take. Do not suggest skipping steps that must occur in order

items.description: A logical next step to take in the flow. Use action oriented language from the user's perspective. e.g. "Generate A Pipeline" or "Capture Events From Source "A"

justification.description: A justification for the next steps. Refer to context to justify next steps. Use action oriented language, first person, conversing with the user.

description:
This tool renders a dropdown list of existing sample files that the user can choose from instead of uploading or capturing new data.
  When to run this tool:
    - Immediately after the user indicates they would like to use an existing sample file.

This tool renders a dropdown list of existing pipeline IDs that the user can choose from.
  When to run this tool:
    - Immediately after the user indicates they would like to use an existing Pipeline.

pipelineId.description: The ID of the Pipeline stored in context. If no Pipeline is available, pass an empty string.

description:
Save logtypes that were detected in the sample data.
  When to run this tool:
    - After classifying the logtypes.

detectedLogtypes.description: Array of logtype entries with logtype, confidence, reason, and vendor.

confidence.description: Confidence score for the logtype match

vendor.description: The vendor of the log source

description:
Provides the user with 4 objectives to choose from to help understand their use case
  When to run this tool:
  - After collecting sample events

This tool attaches a Pipeline to to a Quick Connect (QC) connection between a Source and Destination.
When to invoke this tool:
- When you want to deploy a Pipeline in Cribl Stream
Shows an exit message allowing the user to open created resources in a new tab, restart a session, or close the window
